# Hey, I'm Christiano

🇧🇷 Full stack engineer from Brazil, building software since 2007. I started with `Java` and `Java EE`, moved to `JavaScript` and specialized in frontend, UI and mobile with `React Native`, and these days I spend most of my time on AI products: at Civic I worked on a secure MCP platform for agents and an AI go-to-market tool.

## What I care about

I believe everyone deserves access to the same opportunities and essential services, and that technology should help governments and companies reduce inequality and make the world a better place, not widen the gap. These days I'm spending more of my time on open source and on projects that can make a real difference for people and the planet.
